annotations.title: See how a number’s orders go to the CRM

description: Reads how one WhatsApp number sends its orders to the business’s CRM (HubSpot, Pipedrive or Zoho CRM): whether it is on, the CRM account, the pipeline, and the stage each order status moves the deal to, the defaults included. Also lists the CRM accounts used on the number and the account’s pipelines and stages, read from the CRM now, and why orders cannot be sent when they cannot. Read-only.
